title: Connect your *AI assistant.*
intro: More and more agents plan trips with an AI assistant such as Claude. Plug Local Host's own catalogue into it, and get answers from our data — not from random web pages.

why.title: Answers from the source
why.text: Experiences, places, direct flights, trade-fair dates and sustainability facts, with the same honesty rules as this website.

why.title: Tidier requests, faster
why.text: Ask for a trip request and get a ready-to-send email to our team: countries, interests, length, month and group size.

why.title: Sustainability in seconds
why.text: Our approved Travelife Partner statement and links to all five policies are always one question away.

endpoint.label: Connector URL
endpoint.note: No sign-in, no API key, nothing to install.

steps.title: Add it to Claude
items: Open Claude (claude.ai or the desktop app) and go to **Settings → Connectors**.
Name it **Local Host** and paste the URL above. Leave the sign-in (OAuth) fields empty.
Click **Add**, switch the Local Host connector on in a chat — and ask away.
steps.teams: On Claude Team and Enterprise plans, an owner or admin may need to add the connector for the organisation first.
steps.other: Using Claude Code or another MCP client?
steps.otherText: Any client that supports remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP can use the same URL.

tools.title: What your assistant can look up

descriptions.list_experiences: The six experiences: Culture, Wine, Trekking, Gastronomy, Pilgrim and Leisure.
descriptions.get_experience: One experience in depth: highlights, best places, seasons and who it suits.
descriptions.list_places: Places in Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, by country or experience.
descriptions.get_place: One place: region, approximate coordinates, what's nearby and rough travel times.
descriptions.list_flight_connections: Direct flights to Tbilisi (TBS) and Kutaisi (KUT), and which airlines fly them.
descriptions.get_trade_fairs: The trade fairs where you can meet us, with their next known dates.
descriptions.get_sustainability_commitments: Our Travelife Partner status, commitments and the five policy PDFs.
descriptions.get_contact: Our address, phone and email — and what to include in a quote request.
descriptions.draft_trip_request: Drafts a ready-to-send trip request email to our team. No prices, nothing booked.

examples.title: Try asking
items: Which cities fly direct to Kutaisi?
What could a pilgrimage group see in Armenia?
Draft a 9-day wine trip request for 20 people in September.

limits: It doesn't book, hold, price or send anything, and it collects no personal data. Sending a request email is always your own click.
